problem_statement: ICMP handlers are matched only by ICMP type and code, with no check of the packet's address family. As a result a malformed ICMPv4 packet carrying an ICMPv6 message type can be delivered to a handler registered for IPv6, and vice versa: a handler registered for one IP family receives packets of the other family whose ICMP type happens to match. The network stack must only invoke an ICMP handler when the incoming packet's address family matches the family the handler was registered for.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/icmp -s tests/net/icmp/net.icmp.preempt -s net.icmp.preempt -O twister-out --no-clean -W
